title: Review Provenance
description: Provenance record for a review round. Saved as review/<PR>-round<N>.json.

head_sha.description: Full SHA of the head commit reviewed

base_sha.description: Full SHA of the base commit for the diff

profiles.description: List of applicable profiles from STANDARDS.md

lenses.description: One record per lens (Security, Code, Tests, UX, Consistency)

diff.description: SHA-256 hash of the diff patch file

acceptance_criteria.description: SHA-256 hash of the acceptance criteria with evidence

standards.description: SHA-256 hash of the concatenated standards files

evidence_pack.description: SHA-256 hash of the evidence pack (verify-local output + screenshots)

input_bundle_hashes.description: Hashes of the sanitized bundle inputs for reproducibility

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the round completed

overall_verdict.description: Overall verdict: PASS if all lenses pass, CHANGES if any lens requires changes

lens.description: Which lens this record is for

agent_id.description: Cloud agent ID that ran this lens

agent_url.description: URL to the cloud agent run

requested_model.description: Model ID requested for this lens run

reported_model.description: Model ID reported by the platform. May be 'not reported' if the platform does not report the actual model used.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this lens completed

findings_count.description: Number of findings from this lens

finding_rule_ids.description: Rule IDs cited in findings (if standards violations)

notes.description: Any notes about this lens run (e.g., 'same model as builder')

agent_id.description: Cloud agent ID that ran the evidence collection

e2e_desktop_passes.description: Number of Playwright e2e tests passed on desktop

e2e_mobile_passes.description: Number of Playwright e2e tests passed on mobile
